build: average to lean, subtly softened through the midsection — fit but not athletic-presenting
skin_register: natural pores, minimal makeup, faint fine lines at eyes and brow, healthy but not dewy — lived-in skin
hair: shoulder-to-collarbone length, natural texture, warm brunette or early salt-and-pepper, worn loosely down or in a low relaxed knot — not styled for a camera
wardrobe: fitted dark navy or slate crewneck in a soft matte fabric — jersey or modal weight, no logos, no pattern — tucked slightly or worn neat but not stiff
accessories: simple thin-band watch on left wrist, small understated stud earrings — gold or silver, no necklace, no stacking
expression: composed and direct — eyes steady, mouth neutral with a faint compression suggesting she has heard the wrong answer before and is patiently waiting for a better one — not smiling, not frowning, mid-assessment
body_language: squared shoulders, chin level, weight settled — no lean, no tilt — the stillness of someone who is used to being the most organized person in the room and is quietly unconvinced
register: controlled skeptic — intelligent, self-possessed, quietly fatigued by a category that has underdelivered, not angry but no longer deferential
